EMA seed=nvi[0], alpha=2/(1+255)=2/256, beta=1-alpha; next=currNVI*alpha+priorEMA*beta. Source first-close/first-NVI seed, no SMA255 initialization and no length255 validity delay.
BUY repeated state NVI<EMA; SELL repeated state NVI>EMA; HOLD equality. Preserve source direction and strict comparisons; do not reverse to textbook NVI trend rules or insert crossovers/epsilon.
